_comment: H05 provisioning-as-code: the staging institutional realm, imported at container start (--import-realm). NO USERS, NO SECRETS in this file: the operator identity and its password are provisioned by the one-shot keycloak-provision-operator service from gitignored infra/staging/.env variables. Client registration contract (runbook, docs/verification/program/staging-h05.md): public client 'iraq-aml-frontend', Authorization Code + PKCE S256 (enforced), redirect_uri http://127.0.0.1:18080/auth/callback (the nginx origin), scope openid profile email; an audience mapper adds aud 'iraq-aml-audit-engine' to access tokens (the engine's OIDC_AUDIENCE) and a user-attribute mapper forwards the user's institution_id attribute into verified claims (R10 resolve_identity routes the membership lookup by it). sslRequired=none because the realm is served on loopback-only HTTP (host port 127.0.0.1:18081, container-internal 8080); nothing is published on 0.0.0.0.

clients.name: Burhan institutional frontend (public, PKCE)
clients.description: Authorization Code + PKCE only: no client_secret, no password grant, no implicit flow (spec section 8).
